title: LHB Event
description: A Long-Hu-Ban (Dragon-Tiger List) event for a stock on a trading day.

event_id.description: Unique identifier for the LHB event.

stock_id.description: Identifier of the stock involved in the event.

available_time.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the event became available (business time).

reason_codes.description: Reason codes describing why the stock appeared on the LHB.

total_buy.description: Total buy amount across all participating seats.

total_sell.description: Total sell amount across all participating seats.

turnover_rate.description: Turnover rate for the stock on the event day.

event_confidence.description: Confidence score for the event, between 0 and 1.

source_lineage.description: Provenance lineage for the event data.
